lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for all specific kinds of changes, as each category currently has only one test.

Predictions were occasionally too low, as demonstrated by the home wait_info test exceeding predicted gains.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for specific kinds of changes, as no category yet has at least two tests that agree after noise correction.
Predictions were mostly too high in early rounds compared to measured, noise-corrected results.
Predictions in Round 3 were too low, underestimating winning changes such as sign-in hints and path selection copy.
Changes resulting in no clear effect must be treated as having no effect, even when noise-corrected estimates lean positive.
